query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notificacao_config (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  userId INT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  whatsappNumero VARCHAR(20),
  whatsappAtivo BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL,
  notificarNovasVagas BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL,
  notificarCandidaturas BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL,
  notificarRespostas BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);
